titles: Why Do We Dream? The Fascinating Science of Sleep and Dreams
What Really Happens in Your Brain When You Dream
Dreams Explained: REM Sleep, Big Theories and Strange Facts
long.description: Why do we dream? In this Curious Minds episode, Milo explores what dreams are, how sleep cycles and REM sleep work, why your body is paralyzed while your brain is busy, the major scientific theories about the purpose of dreaming, and some truly strange dream facts, from lucid dreaming to whether animals dream.
